name: DCM Corp.
summary: Primarily operating within South Korea, DCM Corp. is a producer and vendor of various steel plate commodities. Its extensive portfolio encompasses cold-rolled, electro-galvanized, hot-dip galvanized, galvanium, and stainless steel sheets, alongside aluminum coil. The enterprise further offers specialized laminated steel plates and durable laminated weather-proof fluorine films. These components are integral to the production of household appliances, including refrigerators, washing machines, air conditioners, and kimchi refrigerators. Founded in 1972 as Daelim Co., Ltd., the company transitioned to its current designation, DCM Corp., in May 1999. Its central administrative offices are situated in Yangsan, South Korea.
